translation.name: Kazuwamgbani ka savu n Tsikimba n aɓon a ɗa a ɗanga̱sai a kazuwamgbani ka cau

content: Bulus yain kadyanshi ki ara Fesutu
An Fesutu ka̱na̱i manyan ma gomuna ma ne n aꞌayin a tatsu, aku u ꞌya̱nga̱i a Kasariya ubana a Urishelima.
Aku aɗara̱kpi a pige n azapige a aza a Yahuda a tuwa̱i n kadyanshi ka Bulus ara ne. A folo yi
u zuwa a gono n Bulus a Urishelima, kpaci a foɓuso ta̱ ama a pite yi a ure a wuna yi.
Shegai Fesutu wushunku le, “A Kasariya ɗa a ka wundya Bulus, kpam nte ma gono ɗe gogo.
U yan baci ukuna u cingi, a̱sa̱ka̱ azapige a ɗe a tono mu a ba a tuko kadyanshi ki ɗe.”
Fesutu shamgba ta̱ n ele aꞌayin kulla̱ ubana aꞌayin kupa, aku u lazai ugono a Kasariya. An kain ka wansai, u isa̱i aza a kunu ku afada ki, u tonuko le a tuko Bulus vi.
An Bulus tuwa̱i, aza a Yahuda a ɗa a wuta̱i a Urishelima vi a ꞌya̱nga̱i aꞌa̱ri utukuso kadyanshi a kaci ka ne, ka gba̱m bawu a ka fuɗa a shamkpa.
Shegai Bulus ꞌyuwain kadyanshi ki, u danai, “Mpa n nusuka Mele ma aza a Yahuda wa, ko Kuwa ku Kashila̱, ko kpam aza a tsugono tsu Roma wa.”
Shegai an Fesutu wa ciga atakasuvu a aza a Yahuda a pana kayanyan, aku u wecei Bulus, “Ko va wushuku vu bana a Urishelima n ba n yanka vu afada a ukuna u na vi ɗe?”
Bulus wushunku yi, “Wa yan wa, a asuvu a kunu ku afada ku Kaisa ka ma̱ri, kpam nte u gain a yanka mu pini afada. Avu n kaci ka vunu dem vu reve ta̱ mai, n nusuka aza a Yahuda wa.

N yan baci ili i roku iꞌya i rawai ukpa̱, ma ꞌyuwan a wuna mu wa. Shegai ukuna u mayun wa̱ baci pini a asuvu a kadyanshi ka na ki wa, uza u ra̱tsa u neke mu a akere a ama a na yi a wuna mu wa. Ma folo ɗa̱ a ꞌya̱nga̱sa̱ kadyanshi ki ubana ara Kaisa magono ma pige.”
Fesutu dansai kadyanshi ki n asheshi a ne, aku u danai, “Nala wa̱ri, vu folo ta̱ ubana ara Kaisa, kpam nte va bana ɗe.”
Fesutu n Agaripa magono
An a yain aꞌayin kenu, aku Agaripa
magono n uka u ne Baranisi
a tuwa̱i a Kasariya tsa̱ra̱ a ryabusa Fesutu.
An u wokoi a ka yan aꞌayin ɗe, aku Fesutu tonukoi Agaripa ukuna u kadyanshi ka Bulus. U danai, “Vuma roku u ɗa pini a asuvu a kuwa ku aꞌali uza ɗa Feli a̱sa̱nka̱ mu n yanka yi afada.
An ma̱ri a Urishelima, aɗara̱kpi a pige n azapige a aza a Yahuda a tuko mu kadyanshi ka vuma u nala vi, a folo mu n kiɗa̱ga yi ugana.

“Shegai n tonuko le, a mele ma tsunu a̱tsu aza a Roma tsu tsu kiɗa̱ga uza u ugana wa, she a tuwa̱ n eyi a kapala ka aza ɗa a tukoi kadyanshi ki, kpam a tsu a̱sa̱ka̱ yi ta̱ u dansa tsa̱ra̱ u wutukpa̱ kaci ka ne.
An a tuwa̱i adama a kadyanshi ki, an kain ka wansai, n zuwai a tukoi Bulus, aku n gita̱i afada.
Shegai an ama yi a ꞌya̱nga̱i a dansa kadyanshi ki, a tuko unyushi u ɗa a da u yain u ɗa n zuwai katakasuvu n pana vi wa.
Shegai ukuna u adini a le u ɗa, kpam n ukuna u vuma roku uza ɗa a ka isa̱ Yesu uza ɗa u kuwa̱i, shegai Bulus ma̱tsa̱i u da wa̱ ta̱ n uma.
Mpa tani ma̱ri n namba ta̱ tyoku ɗa ma vece ukuna u na vi, aku n wecei Bulus ko wa wushuku u bana a Urishelima tsa̱ra̱ n ba n yanka yi afada yi ɗe.
Shegai u foloi a a̱sa̱ka̱ Kaisa magono ma pige ma pana ukuna vi, aku n zuwai a zuwa yi ve pini a kuwa ku aꞌali ki, hal ubana aꞌayin a ɗa ma tutsuku yi ubana ara Kaisa vi.”
Aku Agaripa tonukoi Fesutu, “Ma ciga ta̱ n pana ili iꞌya vuma na wa dana.” Aku u wushunku yi, “Va pana̱ka yi ta̱ nakpan.”
An kain ka wansai, Agaripa n uka u ne Baranisi a ukai aminya a tsugono, a tuwa̱i kaɓolo n azapige a asoje n azapige a aza a ilyuci yi. Fesutu zuwai a tuko Bulus pini a asuvu a kunu ki.

Aku Fesutu danai, “Agaripa magono, n gba̱ azapige aza ɗa aꞌa̱ri pini na kaɓolo n a̱tsu, wundyai vuma u na vi, aza a Yahuda a ɗa aꞌa̱ri a Urishelima n Kasariya a tuwa̱ ta̱ ara va̱ a ka ciga n wuna vuma u na vi.
Shegai mpa n wene u yan unyushi u ɗa u rawai a ka wuna yi wa. Kpam an u wokoi u foloi a banka kadyanshi ki a asu u magono ma pige, ɗa i zuwai n yawunsai n banka yi ara ne.

U ka̱na̱ ta̱ n korongu ukuna u maci a kaci ka vuma u na ubana a asu u magono. Ɗa i zuwai n tuko yi a kapala ka ɗe gba̱, hal gai avu Agaripa magono, tsa̱ra̱ tsu kotso baci uvece ukuna vi, n tsa̱ra̱ ili iꞌya ma korongu.
Kpaci a uwene u va̱, utengeshi u ɗa a tutsuku vuma ɗa wa̱ri a kuwa ku aꞌali ubana a asu u magono bawu a danai ili iꞌya u yain.”

footnotes.text: Vuma na maku ma Hiridu Agaripa ma, uza ɗa a yain kadyanshi ka ne a 12:1-22. Kala ka te ka yi n tata u ne.
Baranisi maku ma Hiridu Agaripa ma uza ɗa a yain kadyanshi ka ne a 12:1-22. U bansa ta̱ azapige a ama iyolo ushani, gogo‑na kpam utaku u ne ɗa wa wolo.
